dz: 巴莱塔的挑战:在巴莱塔附近13名意大利骑士和13名法国骑士之间的巡回赛.

dz: 塞里尼奥拉战役被打. 它被指为历史上首次由小武器用火药射击而取胜的欧洲战役之一.
de: The Battle of Cerignola is fought. It is noted as one of the first European battles in history won by small arms fire using gunpowder.

t: 克里斯托弗·哥伦布 (Christopher Columbus) 访问开曼群岛，并根据那里众多…
te: Christopher Columbus visits the Cayman Islands and names them Las Tortugas after the numerous turtles there.
dz: 克里斯托弗·哥伦布 (Christopher Columbus) 访问开曼群岛，并根据那里众多的海龟将其命名为“Las Tortugas”。
de: Christopher Columbus visits the Cayman Islands and names them Las Tortugas after the numerous turtles there.

dz: 苏格兰国王詹姆斯四世与英格兰国王亨利七世的女儿玛格丽特·图多尔(Margaret Tudor)在苏格兰爱丁堡的Holyrood Abbey结婚.
de: King James IV of Scotland marries Margaret Tudor, daughter of King Henry VII of England, at Holyrood Abbey in Edinburgh, Scotland.

te: Cardinal Giuliano della Rovere is elected Pope and takes the name Julius II.
dz: 红衣主教朱利亚诺·德拉·罗维尔被选为教宗并取名朱利叶斯二世.
de: Cardinal Giuliano della Rovere is elected Pope and takes the name Julius II.
